units.english: This is a miniature nuclear reactor, used by the Korath to power their fighters.
units.raw: description "This is a miniature nuclear reactor, used by the Korath to power their fighters."

units.english: This massive reactor was designed by the Korath to meet the power needs of their largest ships.
units.raw: description "This massive reactor was designed by the Korath to meet the power needs of their largest ships."

units.english: Korath fighters are not able to recharge their shields, but their larger ships are equipped with one of these.
units.raw: description "Korath fighters are not able to recharge their shields, but their larger ships are equipped with one of these."

units.english: Korath weapons generate extreme amounts of heat, and the cooling systems they require are massive.
units.raw: description "Korath weapons generate extreme amounts of heat, and the cooling systems they require are massive."

units.english: This engine is used by Korath fighters.
units.raw: description "This engine is used by Korath fighters."

units.english: A mass expansion allows you to sacrifice some cargo space in order to make room for more outfits, in situations where you need just a bit more space to install a particular system. It does not increase your weapon or engine space unfortunately.
units.raw: description "A mass expansion allows you to sacrifice some cargo space in order to make room for more outfits, in situations where you need just a bit more space to install a particular system. It does not increase your weapon or engine space unfortunately."

units.english: It is a very rare privilege to be permitted to purchase a Navy capital ship for private use - not just because of a Cruiser's firepower, but because it is a potent symbol of the Republic's strength.
units.raw: description "It is a very rare privilege to be permitted to purchase a Navy capital ship for private use - not just because of a Cruiser's firepower, but because it is a potent symbol of the Republic's strength."

units.english: Only a handful of people in the past century have been given permission to purchase a Navy Carrier, even a decommissioned one, for private use.
units.raw: description "Only a handful of people in the past century have been given permission to purchase a Navy Carrier, even a decommissioned one, for private use."

units.english: An afterburner works by dumping hyperspace fuel into your engines and igniting it, producing a large amount of thrust. This can be very useful for dodging missiles or briefly escaping from faster opponents, but you must be careful to avoid using up so much fuel that you do not have enough left for hyperspace travel.
units.raw: description "An afterburner works by dumping hyperspace fuel into your engines and igniting it, producing a large amount of thrust. This can be very useful for dodging missiles or briefly escaping from faster opponents, but you must be careful to avoid using up so much fuel that you do not have enough left for hyperspace travel."

units.english: Korath Grab-Strike projectiles are designed to pull a target closer to the Korath ship, to keep it from escaping.
units.raw: description "Korath Grab-Strike projectiles are designed to pull a target closer to the Korath ship, to keep it from escaping."

units.english: The Korath like to keep their enemies close... but not too close.
units.raw: description "The Korath like to keep their enemies close... but not too close."

units.english: This anti-missile system helps defend Korath warships from long-range attacks.
units.raw: description "This anti-missile system helps defend Korath warships from long-range attacks."

units.english: The Korath Fire-Lance is a medium-range beam weapon designed to be used by their fighters.
units.raw: description "The Korath Fire-Lance is a medium-range beam weapon designed to be used by their fighters."

units.english: This is the smallest and simplest Korath projectile weapon, designed mostly for use on fighters and drones. As with most Korath technology, it generates a large amount of heat, enough that the gun must pause briefly after every few shots to cool down.
units.raw: description "This is the smallest and simplest Korath projectile weapon, designed mostly for use on fighters and drones. As with most Korath technology, it generates a large amount of heat, enough that the gun must pause briefly after every few shots to cool down."

units.english: Korath repeaters fire compact bolts of superheated plasma at their targets. For every one of these turrets installed on a ship, an auxiliary cooling system is typically required to cope with its heat output.
units.raw: description "Korath repeaters fire compact bolts of superheated plasma at their targets. For every one of these turrets installed on a ship, an auxiliary cooling system is typically required to cope with its heat output."

units.english: This missile is fired from a Korath Piercer Launcher.
units.raw: description "This missile is fired from a Korath Piercer Launcher."

units.english: The Korath Piercer Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Korath Piercer Launchers.
units.raw: description "The Korath Piercer Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Korath Piercer Launchers."

units.english: Korath Piercer Missiles carry a pair of warheads. The first, a smaller one in the very tip of the missile, explodes on impact to blast a hole in the ship's shields to allow some of the subsequent, larger explosion to pierce through.
units.raw: description "Korath Piercer Missiles carry a pair of warheads. The first, a smaller one in the very tip of the missile, explodes on impact to blast a hole in the ship's shields to allow some of the subsequent, larger explosion to pierce through."

units.english: This is ammunition for a Korath Minelayer. Each mine splits into eleven submunitions after it is deployed.
units.raw: description "This is ammunition for a Korath Minelayer. Each mine splits into eleven submunitions after it is deployed."

units.english: The Korath Mine Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Korath Minelayers.
units.raw: description "The Korath Mine Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Korath Minelayers."

units.english: This launcher fires cluster munitions that split into a cloud of stationary mines that each do a considerable amount of damage if a ship crashes into them. However, if a ship hits the mine before it has a chance to deploy, the damage is considerably reduced.
units.raw: description "This launcher fires cluster munitions that split into a cloud of stationary mines that each do a considerable amount of damage if a ship crashes into them. However, if a ship hits the mine before it has a chance to deploy, the damage is considerably reduced."

units.english: Korath Disruptors interfere with a ship's shields, allowing a ship's hull to be damaged even when shields are up. However, they do very little hull damage by themselves.
units.raw: description "Korath Disruptors interfere with a ship's shields, allowing a ship's hull to be damaged even when shields are up. However, they do very little hull damage by themselves."

units.english: This massive beam weapon is relatively ineffective against shields, but cuts through hull armor like it's made of paper.
units.raw: description "This massive beam weapon is relatively ineffective against shields, but cuts through hull armor like it's made of paper."

units.english: This turret fires a tightly focused energy beam that is particularly effective against hull armor. When paired with a disruptor turret, it is a deadly combination.
units.raw: description "This turret fires a tightly focused energy beam that is particularly effective against hull armor. When paired with a disruptor turret, it is a deadly combination."

units.english: This rifle is commonplace among the Korath, predating the creation of the Repeater by at least two centuries. As it uses superheated plasma instead of lasers, the rifle is slow to fire and can sometimes burn its user's hands if they aren't careful. It makes up for these setbacks by guaranteeing that those hit won't live long enough to fire back.
units.raw: description "This rifle is commonplace among the Korath, predating the creation of the Repeater by at least two centuries. As it uses superheated plasma instead of lasers, the rifle is slow to fire and can sometimes burn its user's hands if they aren't careful. It makes up for these setbacks by guaranteeing that those hit won't live long enough to fire back."

units.english: Nanotech Batteries
units.raw: plural "Nanotech Batteries"

units.english: Human engineers who first came into contact with the Quarg were astonished by the sheer efficiency of their technology. The energy density of Quarg batteries is unparalleled, storing nearly a third more energy than the best human batteries while being over a third smaller.
units.raw: description "Human engineers who first came into contact with the Quarg were astonished by the sheer efficiency of their technology. The energy density of Quarg batteries is unparalleled, storing nearly a third more energy than the best human batteries while being over a third smaller."

units.english: The first humans who met the Quarg thought that their technology worked on magic, and many even think so to this day. The mechanism by which this Quarg shield generator works is completely unknown to humanity, and the Quarg aren't interested in giving up their secrets.
units.raw: description "The first humans who met the Quarg thought that their technology worked on magic, and many even think so to this day. The mechanism by which this Quarg shield generator works is completely unknown to humanity, and the Quarg aren't interested in giving up their secrets."

units.english: Intrusion Countermeasures
units.raw: plural "Intrusion Countermeasures"

units.english: Quarg ships are outfitted with special systems for repelling boarders. Because no one wants to be caught by the Quarg with stolen technology, these systems are pretty much worthless on the open market.
units.raw: description "Quarg ships are outfitted with special systems for repelling boarders. Because no one wants to be caught by the Quarg with stolen technology, these systems are pretty much worthless on the open market."

units.english: These immensely powerful beam weapons are used by Quarg warships to strike fear into the hearts of all who dare oppose them.
units.raw: description "These immensely powerful beam weapons are used by Quarg warships to strike fear into the hearts of all who dare oppose them."

units.english: Quarg anti-missile defenses can target projectiles from considerable range compared to human technology, ensuring that only the most powerful missiles are capable of even getting near a Quarg ship.
units.raw: description "Quarg anti-missile defenses can target projectiles from considerable range compared to human technology, ensuring that only the most powerful missiles are capable of even getting near a Quarg ship."

units.english: The metamaterial armor of Successor warships can be altered in an appropriately equipped spaceport to change its attributes.
units.raw: description "The metamaterial armor of Successor warships can be altered in an appropriately equipped spaceport to change its attributes."

units.english: This configuration is designed for exploring hazardous areas, substantially increasing the armor's ability to resist engine-dampening effects and long-term degradation.
units.raw: description "	This configuration is designed for exploring hazardous areas, substantially increasing the armor's ability to resist engine-dampening effects and long-term degradation."

units.raw: ammo `"Nettle" KKV`

units.english: To improve the combat endurance of ships that rely on flooding the battlespace with small missiles, this magazine extends the capacity of Nettle launch cells by loading new Nettle KKVs through the bottoms of the cells.
units.raw: description "To improve the combat endurance of ships that rely on flooding the battlespace with small missiles, this magazine extends the capacity of Nettle launch cells by loading new Nettle KKVs through the bottoms of the cells."

units.english: "Orchid" Nuclear Missile
units.raw: ammo `"Orchid" Nuclear Missile`

units.english: This large ammunition storage loads new Orchid Missiles into the launch tubes with little more than a few cables, actuators, and solenoids. Designed to be as minimalistic as possible, the sheer size of each Orchid nonetheless makes this magazine rather bulky for the number of missiles it stores.

units.english: Z-3600 "Beam" Amat Torches
units.raw: plural `Z-3600 "Beam" Amat Torches`

units.english: The fastest Avgi starships were propelled not just by their engines, but also by immense banks of lasers and particle beams stationed in the Anax system, pushing ships to velocities in excess of 0.2c before braking with a magsail or plasma magnet. Just before the invention of the hyperdrive, however, the Avgi perfected this beam-core antimatter drive, capable of pushing a starship with sufficient antimatter fuel to 0.4c and perhaps beyond. Requiring immense quantities of antimatter, the amat farms around Anax such as Antivli Station would have been strained to their limits had this design entered mass production, but the surprise invention of the hyperdrive rendered it laughably obsolete overnight.

units.english: This canister contains everything required to assemble a Teciimach Torpedo. These weapons emit strong electromagnetic pulses which interfere with a ship's generators and neutralize a portion of their energy.
units.raw: description "This canister contains everything required to assemble a Teciimach Torpedo. These weapons emit strong electromagnetic pulses which interfere with a ship's generators and neutralize a portion of their energy."

units.english: Unlike the previous generation of "EMP Torpedoes," the Teciimach torpedoes actively shape their emission pattern to avoid impacting their allies.
units.raw: description `	Unlike the previous generation of "EMP Torpedoes," the Teciimach torpedoes actively shape their emission pattern to avoid impacting their allies.`

units.english: The Teciimach Canister Rack is used to store extra sets of components, both to expand the capacity of a ship, and on carriers for resupplying fighters.
units.raw: description "The Teciimach Canister Rack is used to store extra sets of components, both to expand the capacity of a ship, and on carriers for resupplying fighters."

units.english: In addition to its ammunition capacity, the storage bay can also contain a small amount of charge, enough to let an otherwise battery-less ship assemble Teciimach Torpedoes.
units.raw: description "	In addition to its ammunition capacity, the storage bay can also contain a small amount of charge, enough to let an otherwise battery-less ship assemble Teciimach Torpedoes."
